pages.title: Differential Manifold
pages.text: A space that looks flat if you look closely enough, though it may curve in any way overall. Calculus works on each small flat patch, and the patches stitch together smoothly. Einstein wrote relativity on exactly this kind of stage. The object folds and flexes in the hand without ever creasing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted calculus on a curved surface, so I glued derivative and integral operators onto a topological insulator patch by patch. The condensate smoothed the seams until no point could tell it was anywhere special.
